items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area chart
items.description: One or more series drawn as a crisp line over a dithered fill that is densest under the line.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: Curtains of light that fold, sway and shimmer, drawn as a dither, with props for colours, curtains, rays, tilt, drift and masks.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A generative avatar drawn from a string as a mirrored dither face on a lit, dithered disc, with an overlapping avatar group.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Vertical bars, grouped or stacked, each filled with a dither and capped with a solid edge.

items.name: beams
items.title: Beams
items.description: God rays from a point or an edge that sweep slowly and fade with distance.

items.name: black-hole
items.title: Black Hole
items.description: A black hole with a thin photon ring and a hot accretion disk seen at a slant, its far side lensed over the top and under the bottom, streaming round with one side brighter.

items.name: cartesian-chart
items.title: Cartesian chart
items.description: The shared frame behind the area, line and bar charts: scales, axes, the hover readout, the legend and an accessible data table.

items.name: contours
items.title: Contours
items.description: A topographic map: contour lines over slowly drifting hills, with heavier index lines and a light hillshade.

items.name: dissolve-text
items.title: Dissolve text
items.description: Text that dissolves in through Bayer thresholds by character, word or line, in any order, settling solid or into a dithered texture.

items.name: dither-button
items.title: Dither button
items.description: A button with a lit, dithered surface that brightens on hover and presses in on click, in four fills, two variants and any palette colour.

items.name: dither-card
items.title: Dither card
items.description: A card with a dithered glow in a corner or along an edge and a dithered rim on its border, which can grow on hover.

items.name: dither-fade
items.title: Dither fade
items.description: A dithered edge that fades a section's content into a solid colour.

items.name: dither-globe
items.title: Dither globe
items.description: A rotating dithered globe with land, a lit terminator, and optional pulsing markers and arcs.

items.name: dither-glow
items.title: Dither glow
items.description: A soft dithered spotlight from an edge, a corner or any point, for heroes and cards.

items.name: dither-gradient
items.title: Dither gradient
items.description: A linear, radial or conic gradient drawn as a dither, with a slow noise drift.

items.name: dither-image
items.title: Dither image
items.description: Any image dithered to a preset (ink, duotone, newsprint, gameboy, riso) or your own palette, resolving from coarse to fine.

items.name: dither-number
items.title: Dither number
items.description: An animated number with tabular digits that roll or resolve through a dither, Intl formatting, prefix and suffix, colour and size presets.

items.name: dither-orb
items.title: Dither orb
items.description: A lit, dithered orb that slowly morphs and leans towards the pointer.

items.name: dither-slider
items.title: Dither slider
items.description: A range slider on Radix Slider whose fill is a Bayer ramp that gets denser towards a lit, dithered thumb, with one or two thumbs, steps, tick marks and a readout.

items.name: dither-switch
items.title: Dither switch
items.description: A Radix toggle switch whose track fills with dither behind the thumb, stepping through the Bayer levels, with a lit dithered knob, four fills and any palette colour.

items.name: dither-tabs
items.title: Dither tabs
items.description: Tabs whose dithered pill or underline indicator glides to the chosen tab, dissolving out of the old one and in at the new one through the Bayer levels.

items.name: dither-text
items.title: Dither text
items.description: Display text whose letters are filled with a dithered gradient, noise, dots or hatching in any palette colour, kept as real, selectable text.

items.name: dither-tokens
items.title: Dither tokens
items.description: CSS variables every dithercn piece reads: ink, paper, cell size, bloom strength and the named colour palette (blue, purple, green, pink, orange, red, grey), tuned for light and dark.

items.name: dithercn-skill
items.title: dithercn agent skill
items.description: An agent skill that teaches Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents to build any dither on the engine. Installs into .agents/skills/dithercn and .claude/skills/dithercn, with the engine and dither-export.

items.name: dithered-logo
items.title: Dithered logo
items.description: An SVG or PNG logo redrawn on a pixel grid with exact edges, a dithered fill and an optional shimmer or scan line.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: A horizontal or vertical dithered rule with fading ends and an optional label.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut chart
items.description: A donut or pie chart drawn in dither cells, with a colour and texture per slice, a spotlight and a centre that follows the pointer.

items.name: dot-map
items.title: Dot map
items.description: A flat world map in dithered dots with pulsing markers, dithered halos and dotted arcs.

items.name: dropzone
items.title: Dropzone
items.description: A file drop area with a dithered dashed border that marches round its edge, thickens and pulls a glow in on drag-over and turns red for a rejected file, with a file list showing dithered progress.

items.name: eclipse
items.title: Eclipse
items.description: A dark disc with a glowing rim and a soft corona that breathes slowly.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: A lit, dithered illustration (box, magnifier, folder or planet) with a title, a description and an action, for views with nothing in them yet.

items.name: fire
items.title: Fire
items.description: Flames rising from the edge of the box, with a hot base, tapering tongues that lick up and tear off, and embers that drift above them.

items.name: flow-field
items.title: Flow field
items.description: A wind map: streamlines of a slowly turning, swirling flow, with bright streaks that travel along them and leave fading tails.

items.name: galaxy
items.title: Galaxy
items.description: A tilted spiral galaxy turning slowly, with a bright core, arms with knots of stars, dust lanes and fixed stars behind.

items.name: gauge
items.title: Gauge
items.description: A radial gauge of dithered blocks that fill in to the value, with the reading in the middle.

items.name: halftone
items.title: Halftone
items.description: Print-style round dots on a rotated grid that grow with a noise, radial or linear source.

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: A calendar or matrix heatmap built from dither cells: each square steps from a few dots to solid, with a readout and a level scale.

items.name: horizon
items.title: Horizon
items.description: A planet's horizon from space: a lit rim, a drifting aurora glow and fixed stars.

items.name: image-compare
items.title: Image compare
items.description: A draggable, keyboard-accessible before and after slider between a dithered image and the original or another dither.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line chart
items.description: Lines for one or more series, with optional dithered range bands and point markers.

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: A small dithered loading indicator: a ring with a comet tail, three dissolving dots, a pulse or a bar.

items.name: logo-marquee
items.title: Logo marquee
items.description: A looping row or still wall of logos in one dithered treatment, with soft or dithered edge fades.

items.name: mesh-gradient
items.title: Mesh gradient
items.description: Three to five colour blobs that drift and blend, drawn as a dither.

items.name: metaballs
items.title: Metaballs
items.description: Soft blobs that drift, merge and split like a lava lamp, as shaded shapes or rings of contour lines.

items.name: moire
items.title: Moiré
items.description: Two fine gratings of lines, rings or mesh laid over each other and sliding slowly, so huge interference bands bloom, sweep and turn across the box.

items.name: noise-field
items.title: Noise field
items.description: A slow, folding noise texture in four styles (smoke, ridges, contours, marble), with a sized mask that clears space for text.

items.name: not-found
items.title: Not found
items.description: A complete 404 block with a big dithered code, a message and actions.

items.name: plasma
items.title: Plasma
items.description: Classic plasma: overlapping sine waves that flow into each other, dithered in two colours or a palette.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: Progress bar
items.description: A progress bar built from dither cells: any fill texture with a solid leading edge, stacked parts, step segments and an indeterminate comet.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar chart
items.description: Series across several axes, drawn as polygons of dither cells whose density steps up ring by ring, with an axis scrub and legend spotlight.

items.name: rain
items.title: Rain
items.description: Rain on a window at night: soft out-of-focus city lights behind the glass, beads that show them brighter like tiny lenses, and bigger drops that slide down in jerky runs and leave wet trails.

items.name: retro-grid
items.title: Retro grid
items.description: A perspective grid floor scrolling towards a horizon under a striped, glowing sun.

items.name: ridgelines
items.title: Ridgelines
items.description: Stacked ridge lines like a pulsar plot, each hiding the ones behind it, with peaks that shift slowly.

items.name: ripples
items.title: Ripples
items.description: Concentric rings spreading from one to four points and crossing like drops on still water.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble text
items.description: Text that resolves character by character through dithered blocks and glyphs, with no layout shift, on mount, in view, hover or text change.

items.name: scroll-reveal-image
items.title: Scroll reveal image
items.description: An image that sharpens from coarse dithered blocks to the full photo as it scrolls into view.

items.name: silk
items.title: Silk
items.description: Folds of silk catching the light, with a bright highlight along each crest.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholders for blocks, text lines and avatars, drawn in dither, with a dense band that sweeps across or a pulse that steps through the Bayer levels.

items.name: smoke
items.title: Smoke
items.description: Soft smoke billowing upward and thinning out, lit from above, with props for scale, height, wind and density.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A tiny inline trend for tables and stat cards: a line, a dithered area and a dot on the latest value.

items.name: starfield
items.title: Starfield
items.description: Dithered stars in three parallax layers that twinkle and drift slowly.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat card
items.description: A KPI card with a value, a coloured delta and a dithered trend area on a dotted surface.

items.name: tunnel
items.title: Tunnel
items.description: A slow flight down a tunnel of round or square rings, with spokes along the walls and fog at the vanishing point.

items.name: uptime-bar
items.title: Uptime bar
items.description: A status-page row of daily dithered bars with per-day tooltips and overall uptime.

items.name: voronoi
items.title: Voronoi Cells
items.description: A cellular surface like soap foam, crackle glaze or raised stone tiles, with walls of one width and seeds that drift so cells swell, shrink and trade edges.

items.name: waves
items.title: Waves
items.description: Layered swells under a glowing horizon, or thin lines like a sound wave.
